title: A Unified Regularity Condition for Optimal Control: Bridging LICQ, MFCQ, and Subdifferentials
summary: This paper presents a unified derivation of transversality conditions in optimal control problems using exact penalty functions. The key regularity condition is that the origin is uniformly separated from the subdifferential of the penalty function in a neighborhood of the admissible set.
